threads.body: This upgrade includes SDK tracing enabled by default since 1.14.0. `setup_otel()` registers a global tracer provider before the five Anthropic clients are constructed, and none disables native tracing. SDK spans will therefore enter the reference capture alongside the scenario's existing instrumentation. This conflicts with the telemetry-suppression guidance in `reference/CONTRIBUTING.md:122-124`. Add `ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY: "false"` under `env` in `conformance.yaml`, or pass `open_telemetry=False` to each client, to keep the capture controlled by the reference instrumentation.
